title: pseudolithos migiurtinus

It is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used in Somali folk medicine for its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pseudolithos migiurtinus include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
